Recurring: stock updates, contractor checks, equipment delivery, safety & compliance. Ongoing responsibilities.

Phased plan — milestones, tasks, resource assignments & dependencies.
Central Hub

Supplier Portal
Pre-qualified suppliers submit offers. Validated on price, lead time & ESG. Procurement marketplace.
B7
Reports
Weekly & monthly reports — project progress, procurement, budget vs. actual, risk register, governance completion. For management and investors.
